scope: 14 declared cross-repository federation edges at the authority-boundary frozen denominator

shared_hub_export_semantics.serialization: manifest.json plus JSONL canonical streams; manifest files bind filename, stream, record_count, sha256, schema_id; package_id is deterministic from sorted filename+sha256 entries plus mode
shared_hub_export_semantics.stable_id_semantics: stream-specific producer IDs: src_, ent_, rel_, awd_, txn_, obs_, alrt_; Hub aggregation may deduplicate identical deterministic IDs but cross-producer real-world identity requires the independent identity authority
shared_hub_export_semantics.cardinality_semantics: package files are 1:N manifest-to-record streams; entity equivalence cardinality is outside the export package and MUST remain candidate/unresolved until identity-plane adjudication
shared_hub_export_semantics.null_semantics: required schema fields must be present and type-valid; optional fields are omitted when unknown unless the stream schema explicitly permits another representation; no silent fabricated values
shared_hub_export_semantics.temporal_semantics: manifest created_at/extracted_at and stream created_at/extracted_at/observed_at are JSON Schema date-time; award_date and transaction_date are date; source-native event time remains distinct from extraction time
shared_hub_export_semantics.crs_axis_units: canonical point locations are WGS84 semantic latitude/longitude in decimal degrees; entity municipality-only attribution is permitted without fabricated coordinates; stream schemas do not authorize centroid fallback
shared_hub_export_semantics.geometry_semantics: optional point/location attributes only at Hub contract layer; producer-domain geometry remains producer-owned; shared canonical geometry is owned by prii-federation-spatial-identity
shared_hub_export_semantics.provenance_semantics: source rows plus lineage.producer_script, producer_phase, source_inputs; manifest SHA256 and record counts bind package bytes; producer facts remain producer-owned
shared_hub_export_semantics.review_promotion_semantics: Hub validation/aggregation does not promote candidate identity or producer review state
shared_hub_export_semantics.dependency_pin_semantics: frozen producer commit plus manifest/file hashes are the edge pin; shared runtime package pins are independently audited
shared_hub_export_semantics.positive_gate: producer federation.json ready_for_hub_discovery=true; package manifest and rows validate against Hub schemas; package hashes/counts reconcile
shared_hub_export_semantics.negative_gate: reject malformed manifest/JSON, wrong schema, wrong producer, missing file, hash mismatch, count mismatch, invalid IDs/timestamps, or forbidden synthetic/live state
shared_hub_export_semantics.replay_semantics: same frozen producer commit and same package bytes/hash set must reproduce the same deterministic package identity and canonical rows
shared_hub_export_semantics.rollback_semantics: retain immutable producer package/commit manifestation; rollback selects prior frozen producer package rather than rewriting producer facts

edges.authority: MoneySweep owns public-money facts; TheHub validates/aggregates only; shared identity remains independent
edges.crs_axis_units: municipality-only finance attribution is valid; no point is invented by MoneySweep
edges.geometry_semantics: MoneySweep finance rows may carry municipality attribution; spatial point derivation belongs to Spiderweb/identity geometry authority
edges.review_promotion_semantics: Centinelas-derived finance remains pre-official until MoneySweep officialization rules close
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: frozen commit and package hashes; live execution explicitly false at frozen manifest
edges.negative_gate: Hub schema/hash/count gates plus MoneySweep readiness blockers

edges.authority: Spiderweb owns spatial operational evidence/geoprocessing; TheHub validates/aggregates only
edges.crs_axis_units: WGS84 point/track outputs where resolved; source/domain geometry remains explicitly attributed
edges.geometry_semantics: unresolved geocodes remain unresolved; no municipality-centroid fallback
edges.review_promotion_semantics: spatial observations do not establish shared identity
edges.negative_gate: reject missing/mismatched producer package, hash/count mismatch, or fabricated fallback geometry

edges.authority: AguaYLuz owns utility/water/grid facts and topology; TheHub validates/aggregates only
edges.temporal_semantics: alerts distinguish observed/start/end from created/extracted time
edges.crs_axis_units: WGS84 point locations; shared municipio/barrio reference is separately authority-pinned
edges.geometry_semantics: utility/domain geometry remains AguaYLuz-owned; shared admin containment reference remains identity-plane owned
edges.review_promotion_semantics: tier/review caveats remain producer facts and are not silently upgraded by Hub
edges.negative_gate: reject invalid alerts/assets, geometry-role ambiguity, or unsupported source promotion

edges.authority: Skywatcher owns aircraft/flight/airspace observations; TheHub owns external imagery/model orchestration but not aviation facts
edges.temporal_semantics: observation observed_at is distinct from extraction/creation timestamps
edges.crs_axis_units: WGS84 lat/lon for observation points; aviation attributes retain producer units
edges.geometry_semantics: aviation observation/track geometry is producer-domain evidence, not shared identity geometry
edges.review_promotion_semantics: unresolved media identities/capture geometry block live execution
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: frozen commit; shared TheHub packages use immutable commit SHA but git+ transport remains a reproducibility follow-up
edges.negative_gate: live readiness remains false until reviewed real corpus/media identity closes

edges.authority: OVNIS owns anomalous/UAP case facts and reviewed promotion; Hub validates/aggregates only
edges.temporal_semantics: case event time remains producer fact; extraction/creation timestamps remain provenance
edges.crs_axis_units: case/location projections may be spatially joined but do not authorize identity
edges.geometry_semantics: case geometry/location remains OVNIS domain fact until shared geometry adjudication
edges.review_promotion_semantics: automated ingestion candidate-only; master promotion reviewed PR only
edges.negative_gate: synthetic or unreviewed candidate cannot silently enter master/promoted semantics

edges.authority: Centinelas owns pre-officialization signals/routing state; Hub logs/validates/aggregates but does not officialize domain facts
edges.serialization: canonical export JSONL/manifest plus routed signal JSON contract
edges.stable_id_semantics: Centinelas signal/item IDs remain producer IDs; Hub cannot convert signal correlation into identity
edges.cardinality_semantics: one signal may route to one or more declared consumers; each routed handoff remains independently receipted
edges.null_semantics: destination schema required fields enforced; unknown domain facts remain candidate/unresolved
edges.crs_axis_units: signal routing does not itself establish geometry authority
edges.geometry_semantics: consumer resolves/validates spatial meaning; route payload is not canonical geometry
edges.provenance_semantics: source URL/name, capture time, signal ID, route target and downstream receipt
edges.review_promotion_semantics: pre-officialization only until consumer/domain promotion gate
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: frozen Centinelas commit and destination schema blob
edges.positive_gate: production export and destination schema validation
edges.negative_gate: reject malformed/stale/synthetic production ledgers and invalid destination payloads
edges.replay_semantics: routed handoffs require idempotency where consumer contract implements durable receipt
edges.rollback_semantics: retain original signal and route receipts; consumer promotion remains independently reversible

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; AguaYLuz owns environmental/utility interpretation and promotion
edges.serialization: JSON handoff envelope with content-addressed idempotency receipt; promoted event JSONL
edges.stable_id_semantics: signal/idempotency IDs retained; consumer event ID is consumer-owned
edges.cardinality_semantics: one handoff -> at most one promoted environmental event per idempotent payload
edges.null_semantics: unsupported/empty signal fails or yields no promotion; no fabricated fields
edges.temporal_semantics: producer capture/publication and consumer event time remain separate
edges.crs_axis_units: handoff does not transfer canonical geometry authority
edges.review_promotion_semantics: consumer promotion under AguaYLuz event schema/tier rules
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: both frozen commits plus Centinelas destination schema blob
edges.positive_gate: valid environmental_signal produces idempotent consumer event
edges.negative_gate: unsupported handoff kind or invalid payload fails closed
edges.replay_semantics: duplicate idempotency key acknowledged without duplicate promotion
edges.rollback_semantics: receipt retained; downstream event correction is consumer-controlled

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; AguaYLuz owns access/safety condition interpretation
edges.contract: aguayluz destination schema + access_condition.v1 consumer schema
edges.serialization: JSON handoff envelope; access_conditions JSONL; content-addressed receipt
edges.stable_id_semantics: condition_id producer/consumer contract retained; certified asset binding uses registry ID
edges.cardinality_semantics: one condition may bind to zero or one certified asset; unbound remains explicit
edges.null_semantics: missing/unknown asset key remains unbound; no fabricated geometry
edges.geometry_semantics: geometry keys are forbidden; exact geometry binding is registry-controlled downstream
edges.provenance_semantics: T1 evidence preserved and original receipt retained
edges.review_promotion_semantics: only validated T1 access condition is promoted
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: both frozen commits and schema/binding registry artifacts
edges.positive_gate: valid T1 condition promotes and may bind certified asset
edges.negative_gate: geometry-bearing, non-T1, unsupported-kind, or invalid-schema payload rejected
edges.rollback_semantics: receipt retained; binding/output correction is append/consumer controlled

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; MoneySweep owns finance candidate and officialization
edges.serialization: JSON intake drops -> JSONL funding_awards.jsonl / transactions.jsonl
edges.stable_id_semantics: signal provenance retained; generated finance IDs remain MoneySweep candidate IDs
edges.cardinality_semantics: one signal may yield zero/one/multiple finance candidate rows depending on extracted facts; no official identity implication
edges.null_semantics: unresolved finance/location fields remain candidate gaps rather than silently promoted
edges.temporal_semantics: signal time and finance event date remain distinct
edges.crs_axis_units: municipality attribution only; MoneySweep does not fabricate point geometry
edges.geometry_semantics: located-finance candidate may carry municipality; point derivation belongs downstream
edges.provenance_semantics: Centinelas source ID retained into finance bundle/report
edges.review_promotion_semantics: explicit pre-official state until MoneySweep officialization
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: both frozen commits plus destination schema/consumer script
edges.positive_gate: FINANCIAL label retained and emitted to candidate streams
edges.negative_gate: non-finance signals excluded; candidate cannot silently become official
edges.replay_semantics: deterministic candidate export expected from same drop set; executable CI pending
edges.rollback_semantics: candidate export can be regenerated from retained source drops

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; MoneySweep owns political-finance/control candidate interpretation
edges.serialization: JSON intake drop -> MoneySweep JSONL candidate streams
edges.stable_id_semantics: signal provenance retained; consumer IDs do not redefine source identity
edges.cardinality_semantics: candidate extraction may be 0:N; cross-entity identity remains separate
edges.temporal_semantics: source publication/capture distinct from consumer event date
edges.crs_axis_units: municipality-only location when available; no centroid fallback
edges.geometry_semantics: political/finance signal does not establish geometry
edges.provenance_semantics: Centinelas provenance retained through MoneySweep candidate/report
edges.positive_gate: POLITICAL label routed to MoneySweep intake
edges.negative_gate: no automatic officialization or identity merge
edges.replay_semantics: same source drop should reproduce candidate projection
edges.rollback_semantics: regenerate from retained drop; officialization separately reversible

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; Spiderweb owns spatial/geology investigation; handoff has identity_effect NONE
edges.serialization: JSON handoff envelope -> immutable JSON receipt
edges.stable_id_semantics: idempotency_key and lead_id preserved; correlation handles are explicitly non-identity
edges.cardinality_semantics: one idempotency key maps to one protected payload receipt; divergent reuse is collision/fork
edges.null_semantics: missing/mismatched lead identity fails closed when project_lead is present
edges.temporal_semantics: payload timestamps retained verbatim; receipt hashes exact canonical payload bytes
edges.crs_axis_units: handoff itself carries no shared geometry authority
edges.geometry_semantics: Spiderweb may derive domain spatial evidence but cannot convert handoff correlation into identity
edges.provenance_semantics: payload SHA256 and full payload retained in immutable receipt
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: both frozen commits plus destination schema blob
edges.positive_gate: first valid payload writes receipt; exact replay idempotent
edges.negative_gate: same idempotency key with different protected bytes produces collision evidence and fails closed
edges.rollback_semantics: immutable receipts retained; downstream derived outputs can be superseded without rewriting receipt

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; OVNIS owns case candidate normalization/review/promotion
edges.stable_id_semantics: source item_id retained as candidate record_id; no master identity assignment
edges.cardinality_semantics: one dispatched signal -> one staged candidate row; candidate dedupe/promotion handled by OVNIS
edges.null_semantics: missing PR location/date/description remains invalid/quarantined; no fabrication
edges.temporal_semantics: published_at coerced only to valid YYYY[-MM[-DD]] date_local; captured_at retained as retrieved_at
edges.crs_axis_units: consumer resolves PR location vocabulary; no producer geometry is trusted as canonical
edges.geometry_semantics: location resolution is candidate context, not shared geometry/identity
edges.provenance_semantics: source URL/name, evidence tier, item ID and capture time retained
edges.review_promotion_semantics: adapter cannot touch master ledger; existing candidate pipeline and reviewed promotion remain authoritative
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: both frozen commits plus OVNIS destination schema blob
edges.positive_gate: valid anomalous dispatch becomes candidate-feed row
edges.negative_gate: non-PR/locationless or schema-invalid row is quarantined; never silently promoted
edges.replay_semantics: pure adapter output deterministically follows event payload; candidate pipeline dedupe remains downstream
edges.rollback_semantics: candidate feed can be regenerated; master ledger unaffected by adapter

edges.authority: Centinelas owns signal; Skywatcher owns aviation/airspace interpretation
edges.serialization: declared routed JSON signal; consumer serialization surface not located at frozen Skywatcher ref
edges.stable_id_semantics: producer item_id defined; consumer binding OPEN
edges.cardinality_semantics: declared route exists; consumer intake cardinality OPEN
edges.null_semantics: producer schema defines required fields; consumer handling OPEN
edges.temporal_semantics: producer schema has published_at/captured_at/routed_at date-time; consumer handling OPEN
edges.crs_axis_units: no geometry fields in producer schema; consumer spatial binding OPEN
edges.geometry_semantics: signal must not itself establish aviation geometry; consumer surface not proven
edges.provenance_semantics: producer source URL/name/item metadata defined; consumer receipt/provenance OPEN
edges.review_promotion_semantics: must remain lead/candidate until Skywatcher review; executable consumer gate not found
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: frozen commits and producer schema blob; consumer contract pin OPEN
edges.positive_gate: OPEN: no frozen consumer adapter located
edges.negative_gate: OPEN: no frozen consumer rejection/idempotency proof located
blockers: Skywatcher frozen ref has producer-side route schema but no located Centinelas consumer adapter/receipt gate

edges.authority: MoneySweep owns finance/project fact; Spiderweb owns spatial scoring/derivation; shared identity remains independent
edges.contract: contract_finance_bundle@1; adapter export_contract_version=1.2.0; 4-file scored-layer bundle optionally guarded by 11-artifact contract_finance_artifact_manifest
edges.serialization: 4-file bundle: GeoJSON awards/flows + CSV municipality density + JSON ingest report; upstream integrity manifest enumerates 11 CSV/JSON/GraphML/reference artifacts
edges.stable_id_semantics: finance record/entity/source identifiers retained; scoring does not create canonical identity
edges.cardinality_semantics: row-level finance records aggregate N:1 by municipality for density; entity convergence/scoring does not imply identity equivalence
edges.null_semantics: bundle GeoJSON geometry is intentionally null because MoneySweep carries municipality attribution only; no point is fabricated
edges.temporal_semantics: bundle date derives from finance event_date; ingest report generated_at UTC; Spiderweb temporal score parses date independently
edges.crs_axis_units: bundle declares EPSG:4326 but geometry is null; municipality crosswalk controls spatial attribution; point derivation is a separate Spiderweb responsibility
edges.geometry_semantics: MoneySweep explicitly emits null geometry; Spiderweb must not substitute municipio centroid; PPP/reference-backed resolution is a separate lane
edges.provenance_semantics: Centinelas contribution surfaced in ingest report; optional 11-artifact manifest binds git_blob_sha artifacts and row-level source of truth
edges.review_promotion_semantics: scoring tiers/review_status are Spiderweb analysis outputs and do not officialize MoneySweep source facts or shared identity
edges.dependency_pin_semantics: OPEN: committed 11-artifact manifest embeds producer commit 17c21ac2f3675895d890bf51a508167de50943c9 while frozen denominator is 74b10245f925bfd9b9ea07b2ce986981d5d65525; consumer validator requires nonempty commit but does not require frozen expected commit
edges.positive_gate: 4 required bundle files must exist; optional artifact_manifest, when supplied, must pass 11-artifact integrity/readiness gate
edges.negative_gate: reject missing 4-file inputs; if manifest supplied reject wrong producer, missing/extra artifacts, missing blob SHA, failed readiness, unclassified unknowns, graph lineage/confidence gaps, false municipio codes, count/amount mismatch
edges.replay_semantics: bundle derives from row-level geo reasoning; exact frozen producer manifestation replay is not yet proven because manifest commit pin is stale relative to denominator
edges.rollback_semantics: source row-level artifacts and frozen commits permit prior-view selection in principle; exact cross-commit rollback receipt remains OPEN
blockers: artifact manifest producer.commit does not match frozen MoneySweep denominator
Spiderweb manifest gate does not enforce expected frozen producer commit
